name.ja: Figure-rise Standard 仮面ライダークウガ マイティフォーム
name.en: Figure-rise Standard Kamen Rider Kuuga Mighty Form

series.ja: 仮面ライダーシリーズ

brands.ja: Figure-rise Standard[フィギュアライズ スタンダード]

categories.ja: キャラクタープラモデル

description.ja: 『仮面ライダークウガ』よりクウガのアクションを体感できるマイティフォームが「Figure-rise Standardで登場！
description.en: From "Kamen Rider Kuuga ", the Mighty form that allows you to experience Kuuga's actions is now available as " Figure-rise Standard"!

description.ja: • 独自の関節機構で強化マイティキックを徹底再現。
description.en: • Thoroughly reproduces the strengthened Mighty Kick with its unique joint mechanism.

description.ja: • 宙返りやキック後の着地ポーズを再現するため、腰に特殊な可動域を開発、搭載。キックアクションのみならず、劇中のあらゆるアクションシーンの再現が可能。
description.en: • A special range of motion has been developed and installed in the waist to reproduce the landing poses after somersaults and kicks. It is possible to reproduce not only kick actions but also all action scenes from the movie.

description.ja: • 膝関節は、ふくらはぎと太ももが接触するまで可動。
description.en: • The knee joint can move until the calf and thigh touch.

description.ja: • 股関節は約120度回転。つま先も可動。
description.en: • The hip joint rotates approximately 120 degrees. The toes are also movable.

description.ja: • 金パーツはメッキで再現。
description.en: • Gold parts are reproduced with plating.

description.ja: • ハンドパーツは７種。握り手左右、平手左右、変身手左右に加え、サムズアップ用右手も付属。
description.en: • 7 types of hand parts. In addition to the left and right grasping hands, left and right open hands, and left and right transformation hands, a right hand for thumbs-up is also included.

description.ja: • ディスプレイ台座、キック用の炎エフェクトが付属。
description.en: • Display pedestal and kick flame effect included.

accessories.en: Gripping hands (left and right) x 1 type each
Hirate (left and right) x 1 type each
Transformation hands (left and right) x 1 type each
